children: announced on Wednesday the launch of Global Trade Navigator, a suite of digital tools intended to make international shipping easier for businesses by bringing customs, duty, tax, documentation, and clearance information earlier into the shipping process. The parcel delivery giant noted that the tools are aimed at reducing delivery surprises, improving shipment data, and helping businesses resolve customs issues before they delay clearance.

The company pointed to the FedEx 2026 Small Business Trade Index, which found that 68% of small and medium-sized businesses regularly encounter customers surprised by duties upon delivery, while 60% report lost revenue from refunds or abandoned purchases. FedEx
sees the new offering as a way to make cross-border costs and requirements more predictable for both merchants and consumers.

Key components include FedEx Trade Planner, a free tool on the FD website that will provide Harmonized System code lookups, estimated duties and taxes, fee estimates, and document recommendations before a shipping label is created. Enhanced FedEx Ship Manager capabilities will help customers review product classifications, customs values, and country-of-manufacture information.

Building on decades of global trade expertise, Global Trade Navigator makes critical trade information and guidance more accessible to businesses as they grow internationally. The result is fewer surprises and a more predictable experience for businesses and consumers," highlighted FedEx

title: FedEx unveils new digital tools to simplify international shipping
